exposure: Apgar scores at 1 and 5 min after birth
cohort: Infants less than 1 year old admitted to Chung-Ang University Hospital from January 2006 to May 2015.  Seizure group (n=93) had history of seizures. Control group (n=296) were age-matched infants with no history of seizures.
finding: Low Apgar scores were significantly associated with increased risk of infantile seizures, especially in full-term and normal birth weight infants.
mod_finding: Apgar scores were strongly associated with infantile seizures in the full-term and normal birth weight groups, regardless of delivery mode.
